name: Arroyo de la Encomienda (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided white over crimson, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Arroyo de la Encomienda (a Maltese cross on red above waves).
history: The arms were officially approved on 27 November 1990 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 7 December 1990. The municipal flag, approved on 11 January 1995 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado of 9 February 1995, is square, of proportion 1:1, divided per fess argent and crimson red in two stripes of the same width, charged at the centre with the municipal arms in their colours.

features.role: Arroyo de la Encomienda arms — Maltese cross on red above waves
